report.verdict: Dental office administration is the work I see first, with a move up from Sales Associate to Assistant Store Manager before it. I'd move on because none of the jobs says what you did in them.
write_up: You're an Office Administrator at Harlow Dental Group, with retail management before that. It's common to see a profile with titles and dates but no job descriptions. Here, that leaves a recruiter without the work behind either role.
The move from Sales Associate to Assistant Store Manager at Brightway is the strongest thread already on your profile. It shows a change in title, but the work behind it isn't written down yet.

Start with the Harlow job: name the work you handle and who you work with. Then add the dental specialty to your headline and describe the Brightway management job. A recruiter hiring for dental office administration could then see what you've done in the job they're filling.

cards.cannot_tell: Nothing introduces the work you do at Harlow or connects it to your management job at Brightway. A short first-person opening can give a recruiter that starting point.

cards.line: The Office Administrator job at Harlow Dental Group has no description.

cards.where: Brightway Home Goods, Assistant Store Manager
cards.line: The Assistant Store Manager job at Brightway Home Goods has no description.

cards.example: [the scheduling or billing software you use] | [a dental office specialty you handle] | [another skill from your daily work]
